label: Compose exercised contributor paths through the selected secondary stroke (inference)
rule: Extend the source's nonempty path by the secondary stroke's actual contributor step
meaning: The source path to this stroke extends to this result event. The secondary's own step yields a nonempty path to the same event. Reusing those witnesses gives credit in its respect to both bearers. The credit interpretation has no rule from an existential sustainer to a productive path.
